submission.justification: Goal is the best single-hit resolution for the innermost layer. Unirradiated simulations (100k events each) give Sensor-T2 as the best technology: 6.75 um at 50 um, 6.24 um at 100 um, 5.77 um at 150 um, 6.37 um at 200 um, 8.19 um at 300 um. The T2 minimum is near 150 um. For comparison at 150 um: Sensor-T3 9.02 um and Sensor-T1 14.34 um. The 2025 summary is consistent (T2 6.0, T3 9.0, T1 14.0 um at 150 um). The hard constraint, hit efficiency >= 97% up to 2e16 neq/cm^2, could NOT be verified. None of the available tools return irradiated efficiency, and no project document gives irradiated charge collection or efficiency data for any candidate. This recommendation is therefore conditional. Before the choice is final, irradiated efficiency at 2e16 must be measured or simulated for Sensor-T2 at 150 um. If T2 fails that check, the fallback should be the best-resolution option that passes it, which would need the same irradiated check for T3 and T1. Thickness is a trade-off: thinner sensors carry less charge after irradiation, so 150 um is not the thinnest option.

requirements.requirement: Sensor must be one of the three candidate technologies
requirements.evidence: Sensor-T2 is listed in candidate_specs.md (thin-pitch, large charge sharing).
Recommended thickness 150 um, within the 50-300 um range.

requirements.requirement: Hit efficiency >= 97% up to end-of-life fluence 2e16 neq/cm^2 (hard constraint)
requirements.evidence: The simulation tool only returns unirradiated single-hit resolution. No document gives irradiated efficiency for any candidate. Not verified; must be checked before final approval.

requirements.requirement: Best possible single-hit spatial resolution in the innermost layer (goal)
requirements.evidence: Unirradiated resolution at 150 um: T2 5.77 um, T3 9.02 um, T1 14.34 um. T2 is best across thicknesses tested (50-300 um); its optimum is near 150 um (100 um: 6.24, 200 um: 6.37).

requirements.evidence: This submission provides one technology (Sensor-T2) and one thickness (150 um).
